topic: Data requirements for Brazil and Campinas
summary_markdown:
The discussion centered on providing a full year of historical data (November 2022 to November 2023) for VIOOH modeling in Brazil and Campinas. Currently, available sensor data is limited: Campinas started collecting data from April-May 2024, and Brazil has virtual sensors starting mid-September 2024.

The client (JCD) requires a full year of data, which will be modeled using typical weekly averages per month (Impressions per Month/Day/Hour). This means the initial model does not require extreme accuracy for every week.

A proposed solution is to copy aggregated weekly data from an available period (e.g., September 20-October 20, 2024) and apply it across all missing months/periods.
decisions: The client requires a full year of historical data (Nov 2022 - Nov 2023) for VIOOH modeling.
It is acceptable to use aggregated weekly data rather than detailed session-level data.
action_items: [p1] will coordinate with Galyna regarding priority and details and follow up early next week.
